interventions.name: LPG Subsidy
interventions.infra_required: Requires LPG infrastructure readiness (lpg_infra_ready_init = true or infra_lpg_grid built in strictly earlier period q < p)
interventions.description: Upfront connection assistance + 5-year transitional cylinder refill subsidy (PMUY in India; NOC refill subsidy + assumed deposit in Nepal). Treated as a one-time 5-year transitional cohort package (Alternative A).

interventions.name: Improved Biomass Cookstoves
interventions.role: Transitional / interim bridge without infra prerequisite
interventions.infra_required: None — deployable in P1 even when rural LPG/grid prerequisites are unready
interventions.description: Forced-draft or improved biomass stoves with 5-year hardware replacement + 5%/yr O&M. Under GBD concave COPD exposure–response, field PM2.5 reductions (32–50%) translate to ~0.15–0.30 COPD PAF reduction (proposed central 0.25 vs 0.45 mock).

interventions.name: Electric Induction Cooking
interventions.infra_required: Requires grid readiness (grid_ready_init = true or infra_lpg_grid built in strictly earlier period q < p)
interventions.description: Zero point-of-use PM2.5 induction cooktop + 15A internal household wiring package (EESL NECP retail benchmark in India; AEPC/NEA in Nepal). Excludes 5-year household electricity tariffs and lacks a central Indian cash subsidy.

interventions.name: LPG / Grid Infrastructure Prerequisite
interventions.infra_required: Binary trigger when decision variable x >= 0.5; unlocks LPG & induction in periods p > q
interventions.description: Regional rural distribution feeder/transformer reinforcement and LPG bottling/depot expansion. Fixed regional $M capex remains an UNRESOLVED GAP (null) in real sourcing — proxies like Saubhagya ($68/HH) and RDSS ($571/HH) reflect household hookups rather than regional cooking-capacity capex.
